commit: feat(utils): support multiple certificates in resolveServerUrls

truth.description: extractHostnamesFromCerts now reads only certificate values that are strings, but the dev server's listen in server/index.ts passes resolveServerUrls the httpsOptions that resolveHttpsConfig built by reading a server.https.cert file path into a Buffer, so a server whose certificate is set as a file path or a Buffer no longer lists the certificate's hostnames among its local URLs.

distractions.why: The https options come from the same https setting that makes the protocol https, so a certificate is only present when the protocol is https and the added URLs keep the https scheme.
